rules: Group 1 (bottle has a kosher symbol) and group 3 (approved ONLY if the bottle bears the symbol) are separate lists and are never merged.
No kosher status, note, symbol or brand/product wording was altered.
A cask finish never changes the category.
Rye whiskey is filed as Rye, not Bourbon and American Whiskey.
Canadian, Irish and Japanese whisky are never filed as American.
